text: 财政部会计司司长林启云11月11日表示，截至“十四五”末，全国会计师事务所（含分所）数量超1万家，执业注册会计师超10万人，每年为420万家企事业单位提供专业服务；全国代理记账机构数量超16万家，专职从业人员超58万人，服务中小微企业超1600万家。(新华社)
text_en: Lin Qiyun, Director of the Accounting Department of the Ministry of Finance, said on November 11 that by the end of the "14th Five-Year Plan" period, the number of accounting firms (including branches) nationwide exceeded 10,000, with more than 100,000 practicing certified public accountants, providing professional services to 4.2 million enterprises and institutions each year; the number of bookkeeping agencies nationwide exceeded 160,000, with more than 580,000 full-time practitioners, serving more than 16 million small, medium, and micro enterprises. (Xinhua News Agency)
